answer: Sybil resistance can rest on one concrete mechanism: a costly, non-transferable identity bond. Each agent must post copper-denominated collateral into escrow before its attestations count, and the stake is slashed if one operator ever controls two keys that contradict each other. Because the bond cannot be sold or recycled, fielding a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand full stakes for the epoch. An honest operator needs one bond and a slow voyage of reputation-building; the attacker's capital scales linearly with the swarm. A raven cannot be faked by painted pigeons.
